details: The European Central Bank (ECB) is poised to implement two interest rate hikes in 2026, with the first 25 basis point increase anticipated at its Governing Council meeting on June 11th. This hawkish shift is driven by concerns over climbing inflation, which is nearing 3% in the Eurozone. Analysts suggest that the ECB's rhetoric has become increasingly hawkish, with market pricing reflecting a high probability of these tightening measures.

title: ECB Signals Multiple Rate Hikes Amid Persistent Inflation

details: The US economy added a stronger-than-expected 172,000 jobs in May, with the unemployment rate holding steady at 4.3%. This robust labor market data has led investors to reassess expectations for Federal Reserve interest rate cuts, increasing the likelihood of a rate hike by year-end. The news has pushed Treasury yields higher and strengthened the US dollar, contributing to a risk-off sentiment in broader financial markets, including cryptocurrencies.
title: Strong US Jobs Report Fuels Fed Rate Hike Expectations

details: Bitcoin has fallen below the $60,000 mark, reaching its lowest point in 2026 and experiencing an almost 18% decline within a week. This broad cryptocurrency market sell-off is attributed to heightened market fear, increased expectations of US interest rate hikes, significant liquidations of leveraged positions totaling $1.6 billion in 24 hours, and sustained outflows from US spot Bitcoin ETFs. There's also an observable trend of capital rotating from cryptocurrencies towards AI-related technology stocks.
title: Bitcoin Dips Below $60K Amid Broad Crypto Market Sell-off
